items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And then I spent a band we struck that was Joe Oliver, myself, Paul Baldwin, Louis Russell, Bud Scott, our, our, our, Donnell Howard, Albert Nicholas, and our, Bonnie.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then I spent a band we struck that was Joe Oliver, myself, Paul Baldwin, Louis Russell, Bud Scott, our, our, our, Donnell Howard, Albert Nicholas, and our, Bonnie. That's right. That's right. Then later on, Donnell went to China with, with, with, with Jack Carter and we got Billy Page in the band. I didn't know him. You see. Then there's some misunderstanding, something come up later on, the door between Nick and Bonnie and Bonnie and then when Donnell come back, then Nick decided that he would go up.
Oh yes, and he went around the whole world. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And then after he left, then Bob Shaffler came with me. And he stayed with the man until I left.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was Tommy and King. See, Lewis left us to go with Fletcher Hennessy in 24. Tommy took his place. Then he went with this man, or I forgot, Sam Wooden. And then after he left, then Bob Shaffler came with me. And he stayed with the man until I left.
Did you work with Louis at the same time with King Arthur? Yes. You were there. Yes, yes. I was in band with Louis. That's it. Did you make many tours? Yes, we toured in Pennsylvania.
